inventory.rule: Parse both Lami-results and Lami-results2. Forward-fill batch, electrode, owner, encapsulation date and material only inside each sheet's sample block. A non-empty Material or Sample ID starts a sample; following rows contain additional observations until the next sample.
manualDateOverrides: Ambiguous source dates are resolved in the normalized workbook and retained with their original text in encapsulation_date_raw.

iv.voltage: Legacy simple V-I exports contain millivolt values even when the header says V [V]; curve_voltage_scale_to_V records the applied 0.001 conversion.
iv.current: Simple V-I current is divided by cell area; multi-cell V-J exports already contain current density. Generated-current density reverses the instrument sign.
iv.matching: All file-to-sample decisions, alternative scores, reasons and margins are versioned in the IV_Files and Match_Review sheets. Ambiguous and unmatched files remain excluded by default. Non-encapsulated and silicon reference cells use reference_unassigned; unresolved files already stored in laboratory Trash folders use audit_only. These audit sources are preserved but are not counted as polymer-matching failures.
iv.preEncapsulationReferenceLinking: The browser package keeps non-encapsulated files as reference_unassigned but adds a separate reference_sample_uid only when the recorded box and cell/R-reference resolve to one Lami-results2 sample. Orange-box links use the documented cell sequence plus R-reference; Flag-box links require a unique R-reference across batches A2 and A3. Unresolved references remain unlinked.
iv.qa: Source flags and conservative physical plausibility checks are additive; no raw value is deleted.

outdoor.dailyPR: Median PR for rows with irradiance >= 200 W/m2.
outdoor.dailyPmpp: Median Pmpp over the same daylight rows. For electrical-only files without irradiance, median positive Pmpp is retained with an explicit QA flag.
outdoor.dailyIrradiance: Median irradiance over the same daylight rows.
outdoor.retentionBaseline: Median of the first 3 to 7 QA-valid daily values for the same sample and metric; 3/7/14-day sensitivity is reported when enough data exist.

notes: Raw files are immutable and their aggregate SHA-256 is embedded in every .ivpack.
The processed workbook remains the auditable normalization decision ledger.
The compact browser package is rebuilt deterministically from versioned processed artifacts.
